name: 03 - Negative Item Analysis
description: Analyzes each negative credit item via Claude against FCRA rules, saves analysis to DB, compiles dispute strategy by bureau.

parameters.query:
SELECT item_id, case_id, bureau, creditor, account_number_masked,
       item_type, reported_status, balance, date_opened,
       date_reported, raw
FROM negative_items
WHERE case_id = '{{ $json.case_id }}' AND analysis_status = 'pending';

parameters.jsCode:
const inp = $input.first().json;
return [{ json: { ...inp, rationale_safe: (inp.rationale || '').replace(/'/g, "''"), fcra_sections_json: JSON.stringify(inp.fcra_sections || []) } }];

parameters.query:
UPDATE negative_items SET
  dispute_basis = '{{ $json.dispute_basis }}',
  fcra_sections = '{{ $json.fcra_sections_json }}'::jsonb,
  rationale = '{{ $json.rationale_safe }}',
  confidence = {{ $json.confidence || 0 }},
  analysis_status = '{{ $json.analysis_status }}',
  analyzed_at = now()
WHERE item_id = '{{ $json.item_id }}'
RETURNING item_id, case_id, bureau, creditor, dispute_basis, confidence, analysis_status;
